data.revised_prompt:
Create a 2D game FX sprite sheet, exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four animation frames. Style: clean HD hand-painted underwater card-game effect, high contrast, readable at small card size. Background outside the FX must be solid #FF00FF (magenta) everywhere. No card, no UI, no text, no icons, no borders, no guide lines, no labels, no safe-area marks.

Use the provided 2x2 guide only for cell placement, spacing, and centering. Each frame must be centered in its cell, consistent scale across all four frames, and contained within the central 65 percent of each cell. Nothing may cross cell edges.

Frame 1 (top-left): compressed cyan-white energy dot with tiny bubbles, tight and concentrated.
Frame 2 (top-right): teal ink-like shockwave burst with a bright white core, slightly more spread than frame 1.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): expanding circular turquoise ripple, pearl highlights, short bright spray strokes, clearly larger ring form.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): fading blue-green droplets and a thin shockwave ring, dissipating and softer than frame 3.

The effect should feel like an ocean-magic bomb trigger on a playing card face, but show only the FX itself. Keep the composition centered in each cell, with clean edges and strong silhouette for game sprite use.
